artworks.title: Jacques Callot
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a man drawing at a table. He is facing the viewer with his head turned slightly to the left. He has a mustache and shoulder-length hair. He wears a high-collared shirt with lace trim and a buttoned jacket. On the table are drawing instruments, an inkwell, and paper. The background has a simple, cross-hatched texture.

artworks.title: Baker Sounding His Horn
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, leaning on a ledge with his left arm and holding a horn to his mouth with his right hand. He has prominent eyebrows, a straight nose, and a slightly open mouth. The man wears a loose-fitting, long-sleeved garment, and a cap on his head. Behind him is a window frame with a diamond lattice pattern, and in the background, a wooden structure with vines or flowers around a window. The name "A. Ostade" is inscribed above the man's head.

artworks.title: Bust of a Peasant in a Pointed Fur Cap
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man with deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard and mustache. He wears a hat and a thick coat with a large collar. The background is plain. There is a faint signature or inscription on the left side of the image, but no additional objects or jewelry are visible.

artworks.title: Peasant at a Window Holding a Pipe and a Jug
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.7 × 15.4 cm (7 3/4 × 6 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a half-body view of a person within a window. The individual is seen in profile, leaning against the window sill, turning their head towards the viewer with a slight smile. Their facial features include a prominent nose and a jovial expression. The person wears a cap and a large cloak, and is holding an object in one hand and a long-stemmed pipe in the other. Surrounding elements include a window frame, a wall with vines and leaves, all depicted in a richly etched, monochromatic style.

artworks.title: Peasant Couple in a Doorway
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed irregularly to plate mark): 16 × 12.7 cm (6 5/16 × 5 in.)
artworks.description: This print depicts two people standing closely together within an arched window or doorway. The person on the right is a woman, leaning over the windowsill, her body turned towards the right. She has pale skin, arched eyebrows, a long nose, and wide lips set in a smile. She wears a white headscarf covering her hair and is dressed in a simple dress with long sleeves. On the left and partially behind her is a man who is mostly in shadow. He has high cheekbones and deep-set eyes and is also smiling. He is wearing a dark coat and a wide-brimmed hat that sits at an angle on his head. He reaches one hand around the woman, placing it near her breast, and she has one hand on his wrist. The area behind the two people is black, but on the right leafy vines crawl down the side of the archway, and a lattice-like window is partially visible.

artworks.title: Man and Woman Conversing In Front of an Inn
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.6 × 7.9 cm (3 3/4 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows two people standing, seen from the knees up. The person on the left is turned away from us, facing the other individual. They are wearing a bonnet and a long-sleeved dress with an apron, and have a woven basket hung over one arm. The person on the right faces partially towards us but is turned slightly to the left, looking towards the other person. This person is wearing a large hat and a cloak over a buttoned vest with a ruffled collar and trousers with a wide belt. They have deep-set eyes, a large nose, and a partially open mouth. The background displays three tall buildings with pointed roofs, one of which has a sign hanging from it, tall leafy trees, and a sky with a few clouds.

artworks.title: Three Peasants at an Inn, One Looking Down a Jug
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.4 × 8.9 cm (4 1/8 × 3 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: Three men are seated at a small table. The man on the left is pouring liquid from a jug, while the man in the middle watches closely. The man on the right is holding a spoon. They are all wearing hats and loose-fitting jackets. The background features a simple arched doorway.

artworks.title: Peasant Family on a Porch with a Girl Reaching for a Doll
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures: a woman holding a young child and a man observing them. The woman and child are shown from the waist up, with the woman seated while holding the child on her lap facing the viewer. The man stands behind them, leaning over a ledge or table. The woman's face is soft, and she wears a headscarf. She is dressed in a detailed dress with puffed sleeves. The child also wears a headscarf and reaches towards the woman's face. The man has a mustache, wears a cap, and gazes at the woman and child, leaning on the ledge with arms crossed. Nearby is a bench with a pot and spoon. The background displays a wall, a window with diamond-patterned panes, and a vine with dense foliage above the family.

artworks.title: Knife Fight Among Peasants
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures engaged in a physical altercation in a dimly lit room. The central figure raises an arm, and the others are either participating or reacting. The figures are detailed and expressive, rendered in a cross-hatching technique. There is a curved window in the background with slivers of light shining through.

artworks.title: Four Men at a Window, One Reading from a Sheet by Candlelight
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.8 x 18.9 cm (9 3/8 x 7 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three people standing behind a window divided by a wooden cross frame. The person on the left holds a lit candle, illuminating the faces of the others. This individual wears a hooded garment and gazes at the candle. In the middle, another person leans in, partially showing their face and smiling while wearing a cap. The third person on the right holds a piece of paper, closely examining it. They have prominent eyebrows and a slightly open mouth. The individuals wear loose-fitting clothing similar in style, resembling robes or tunics. The window frame above them is decorated with vines and a suspended jug. The background is dark, focusing on the figures, the candlelight, and the paper.

artworks.title: Peasant with a Crooked Back Leaning on a Stick
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.8 × 6.3 cm (3 1/16 × 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person holding a walking stick while leaning forward slightly. The person's face is in profile, showing a prominent nose and brow. They are wearing a brimmed hat, a long coat, pants, and shoes. The background is textured, with a rounded border at the top.

artworks.title: Interior of a Barn with a Peasant Woman at Work
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.8 × 19.5 cm (6 1/4 × 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of a rustic barn or shed, featuring a wooden door on the left, a sloping roof with exposed beams and thatch. The color palette is black and white, highlighting textures and shading. There are various rustic objects like barrels and a cartwheel scattered throughout the space.

artworks.title: Peasant Couple Walking
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures walking together. Two individuals are in conversation, both leaning towards each other as they walk. One figure wears a cloak with a hood while the other has a tall, pointed hat. There is movement in their steps, with their clothing flowing. The drawing shows fine, linear details in the clothing. The background is simple, focusing on the figures and their interaction.

artworks.title: Two Peasants Outside a House, the Woman Winding Wool
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals outside a building. The first person, seated on a bench, is visible from the waist up. They are slightly hunched over, interacting with something in their hands. This seated person appears to be an older individual, wearing a headscarf and a long garment. The second person is standing, facing the seated person, with most of their body visible except for the lower legs. This standing individual wears a hat, a thick coat or jacket, and holds a tall stick. Their facial features are not clearly defined, as the person is looking downwards toward the seated individual. The background setting presents a rustic scene with a building featuring leaded glass windows and creeping plants along the walls. Planks and domestic items, like what looks like a broom or brush, are scattered around, indicating a domestic or rustic outdoor setting, with chickens roaming freely across the ground.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Bridge and Two Fishermen
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge spanning a body of water. Two figures are on the bridge, one sitting and one standing near the water. The scene is depicted in an etching style with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating texture. It is monochromatic with shades of black and white. In the background, there are trees and a house, adding to the rural atmosphere.

artworks.title: Street Vendor Selling Spectacles at the Door
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 10.2 × 8.8 cm (4 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene involving a dwelling. The image depicts a rustic scene at the entrance of a thatched structure. There is a window with a simplistic lattice pattern to the right. A person stands before the doorway, facing two other characters. The figure in the doorway is holding a pipe. The setting is rural, with unpaved ground, surrounding foliage, and simple building materials like wood and straw. The composition is created using fine lines and cross-hatching for shading and texture.

artworks.title: Smoker on a Stool Conversing with a Cobbler at Work
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cobbler at work in a rustic setting. The scene captures an outdoor environment with a wooden structure acting as a makeshift workshop for the cobbler. The cobbler is seated inside a small, low space below a sloped roof, working on a shoe. Various tools and shoes are scattered around. Above, atop the roof, a cat is peacefully sleeping. The background features elements such as ivy climbing up a wall, a window with leaded glass designs, and an old water pump.

artworks.title: Farmstead wtih a Peasant Family Outside the Front Door, the Woman Spinning
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.6 × 17.4 cm (5 3/8 × 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a rustic structure or farmstead. The structure is made of rough wooden planks and two pigs are in the foreground. To the right, there are people engaged in various activities, including two women with a child and an infant, a table with objects, and a birdcage hanging above. The horizon is low in the image with trees and buildings in the distance. The etching style features detailed lines and cross-hatching to define texture and shadow, using a monochromatic palette of black ink on a lighter background.

artworks.title: Painter in His Studio
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an artist at work in a studio. The room depicted is detailed, showing an artist seated at an easel, painting. The interior is rustic, with large arched windows letting in light. A workshop with wooden beams overhead, shelves holding books and tools, sculptures, and paintings on the walls. An arch leads up spiral stairs. The painting captures the texture of the wooden floor and light and shadow. It is in the style of a 17th-century Dutch painter.

artworks.title: Peasant Family in an Interior wtih the Father Feeding a Child
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic interior scene featuring various household items. The drawing depicts the inside of a modest, rustic home with a visible bed in the background, covered neatly with blankets. To the side, there is a small table with a lamp and other household objects placed on it. The composition includes a cooking area with a hanging pot and cooking utensils nearby. The floor has pieces of cloth or garments casually placed or discarded. The year '1648' is inscribed, and the style features intricate linework typical of historical pen drawings.

artworks.title: Peasant Family Praying Before a Meal
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.3 x 13 cm (6 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene with a small group gathered around a wooden table. The room features a rough-hewn floor and simple furnishings, with an old ladder against the wall. Light illuminates the scene from the upper left, and a bowl with a ladle is on the table. The shading and cross-hatching techniques resemble early printmaking styles, creating depth and texture. Shadows from the figures add warmth and intimacy to the scene.

artworks.title: Peasants Outside an Inn Entertained by Musicians with a Flute and a Drum
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic outdoor scene. The scene features a group of individuals gathered outside a rustic building. One large figure is interacting with a smaller figure, another figure leans against the building. The building has visible architectural details such as wooden beams, a small window with a lattice design, a thatched roof, and plates or signs above the door. In the background, there are trees. The shadows and textures are rendered with hatching, and the artist's signature, "Arthade," is visible.

artworks.title: Two Peasant Women Conversing on a Village Street
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two elderly women standing and facing each other. They appear to be engaged in conversation, with one woman slightly leaning forward while the other stands upright. Both women have their heads covered with scarves, and their facial features are drawn with detailed lines, suggesting age with noticeable wrinkles. Their hair is not visible due to the head coverings. They are dressed in long coats and skirts, typical of an older, traditional style of clothing. There seem to be no visible jewelry items on either woman, and each holds a shawl or cloak wrapped around themselves. The setting is an outdoor street scene with trees and buildings as a backdrop. There are additional figures in the background, contributing to the rustic and communal feel of the scene. The area looks cobblestoned and quaint with a rural ambiance.

artworks.title: Quack Doctor Presenting his Potions to a Group of Bystanders
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15 × 12.4 cm (5 7/8 × 4 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people at a marketplace. Five individuals are visible, with four fully shown and one turning towards the viewer. The central figure stands behind a covered barrel, surrounded by others. One person is bending forward with a basket, and a child stands in the foreground facing the central figure. The person on the far right holds a long object, possibly a stick or sword, and is dressed in a cloak and hat. The individuals are dressed in long robes and hats, suggesting a rural setting. In the background, there are tents and trees, depicting an outdoor trading scene under foliage. The image is in black and white.
